MAIN Hakiqa logo for all official use and for all logo animation: the full-colour four-panel symbol (hakiqa-mark-full). Neutral fields only (white, warm white, light grey). Never on navy, orange or teal: one panel disappears. On brand-colour or dark fields use a one-colour mark (white or orange by default). No gloss, shine or glow. Decided by Marvin 2026-10-09. See docs/brand/HAKIQA_LOGO_USAGE.md (field rules).
Red #D0181F one-colour mark. White, warm white and light fields. Not on navy (2.9:1). Same geometry as the approved symbol. Approved by Marvin 2026-10-09.
Teal #00A5B8 one-colour mark. Navy and dark fields; borderline on white. Same geometry as the approved symbol. Approved by Marvin 2026-10-09.
Cyan #01ECFF (--bp-cyan) one-colour mark. Navy and dark fields only; fails on white. Same geometry as the approved symbol. Approved by Marvin 2026-10-09.
